notes: Secret Facility activation reward wiki typo 1003349 corrected to native 103349.
Published reward milestones replace, rather than merge with, native rewards for all 52 listed sets; bundled earlier rewards are not paid twice.
Greenhouse Administration has no published reward rows; its native client rewards are retained. Four event sets have no defined rewards.
Encroachment Set: published upgrade cost group 15 overrides differing client levels.
Unsupported native-only decomposition IDs excluded (absent from effective DB and published whitelist): [27266, 300483].
Native integer odds use denominator 100000; retained when published percentages round or are blank.
Rune and tablet IDs identify persistent registrations; they are not physical items.
Unquantified published reward entries mean one item. Rewards are claimed once per RO login account; PN has no cross-account master-account mapping.
Eight additional Chapter 1 sets present only in client tables are outside published scope.
